question: In a certain code language, 'MAGNETIC’ is written as 'DJUFOHBN' and 'ELECTRIC' is written as 'DJSUDFMF'. How will 'LOCATION' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'MAGNETIC’ is written as 'DJUFOHBN',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb673b9f2ba324c2a82dce09e60e61fe4ba75e1904412d430aec23a7ba1d4ded.png] 

For, 'ELECTRIC' is written as 'DJSUDFMF',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f79ae12002a03dac08f2ef3e836ad63f73188275025f1b5d50b83d0347f580e5.png] 

Similarly, for '**LOCATION**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/554f2d7cdbb3e325e1403bb7e005f70ad636d79efe5b8caaeff72ae19f345aa8.png] 

So, 'LOCATION' will be written as '**OPJUBDPM**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
